warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE 2.0d Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your XE 2.0d is a pre-2017 model with the AJ200D diesel engine, timing chain and injector seal wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by numerous JLR specialist reports. We replace the timing chain, injectors, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. This is the most common issue on the early Ingenium diesel, and addressing it during a rebuild prevents future failure.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages per VRF-jaguar-xe.md.
